args.title: Corvid Packaging Newsletter Summary — Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Corvid Packaging's latest newsletter ("Freight pricing this quarter") links to a blog article and a reader-tailored companion piece on freight pricing trends.
- Main article: spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Companion piece: shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
